text:
ada: Anyone else hear the repo singing last night? My `CHANGELOG.md` did a full acapella run.
tom: was it in D major or semver minor?
sam: it hit an unexpected note — v1.2 -> v1.10 in the bridge. crowd went silent. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
lina: haiku for the build:
lina: ```
broken pipeline
tabs hiding in the soft night
semver takes the stage
```
ci-bot: [ci] lint failed on main — yaml-lint: unexpected tab at line 8 :robot_face:
ada: who merged that tab? tag them for eternal shame :ghost:
tom: honestly think the tab is a ghost. it only shows up during full moons and PRs.
sam: poll: what's scarier: a semver jump that skips a minor, or a YAML that parses differently on prod?
lina: YAML on prod. that's when you hear the whisper: "it worked locally" :sweat_smile:
ada: prize for tonight's karaoke: best release-note rewrite. winner gets to rename a branch to `spooky-semver`.
ci-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze at 22:00. If you push a spooky semver after that, expect ritual linting.
tom: i'll practice my dramatic reading of a changelog that only contains emojis. :jack_o_lantern: :ghost:
sam: RSVP +1. bringing a kazoo and a diff file from 2019.
ada: deployed an emergency linter: `git commit --amend --no-ghosts`. works 0% of the time, every time.
ci-bot: Added label `needs-exorcism` to PR #421 :ghost::exclamation:
